license.name: Apache-2.0 (MODNet upstream ZHKKKe/MODNet; ONNX export Xenova/modnet)

descriptor.role: Trimap-free portrait matting — REAL alpha-channel foreground separation for background removal and background effects.
descriptor.limitations: Trained for portrait/people subjects; on strongly non-human subjects the matte can be conservative — every run carries measured coverage stats and fails honestly when no usable subject is found.

license.name: Apache-2.0 (OpenCV Zoo inpainting_lama; upstream big-lama saic-mdal/lama)

descriptor.role: Large-mask structural inpainting for object removal and approved destructive edits — real model-based region synthesis.
descriptor.limitations: Fixed 512x512 internal resolution (result restored to the working image geometry); not an identity-preserving face generator — identity drift is disclosed in provenance.

license.name: MIT (RIFE upstream hzwer/Practical-RIFE; ONNX export FuryTMP/RIFE_fp32)

descriptor.task: neural frame interpolation (two frames -> middle frame, [1,6,H,W] input)
descriptor.role: REAL neural frame synthesis for the JAZMII local image-to-video lane: animates a still with motion programs and generates in-between frames with the model (never a static image).
descriptor.limitations: Frame interpolation of motion trajectories — NOT diffusion scene synthesis. New content/subject motion is out of scope for this lane; provenance states the lane class on every result.

license.name: Apache-2.0 (U-2-Net upstream xuebinqin/U-2-Net; u2netp portable build via rembg)

descriptor.role: Lightweight general foreground/saliency map used as the fallback matte when the portrait model finds no usable subject.
descriptor.limitations: Saliency-quality matte; edges are softer than MODNet. Chosen for a 4.6 MB footprint, not for hair quality.
